source.author: Giuseppe Pitrè
source.pdf_source: user-conversation-attached 1900 Michigan/Internet Archive compressed original scan

methodology: Rendered and visually inspected contact sheets for every distinct relevant PDF page, cross-read original Italian embedded text for each of 87 records, required 87/87 normalized exact-anchor matches, and used the printed book foliation in each original page (not line interpolation). PDF page references are one-based, and in this section printed page + 58. Original older source IDs unchanged. Occasional original scan OCR anomalies appear inside literal Italian anchors and must not be silently modernized.
specific_editorial_holds: Ribera/St Joseph page 448 mentions 'pane consacrato' in a quoted correspondent account after sung Mass. This does not by itself prove Eucharistic species, or a specific authorized Roman Ritual bread blessing.
Agatha candelore and Syracuse and Melilli historical observances reflect one compiler's evidence, including named older sources; printed witness is verified but author independence is not.
Palazzolo Acreide live snakes and related folk healing beliefs remain historic claims, never instructions for app users.
Sicilian devotional feast dates in this 1900 volume must not be exported as verified current or 1962 universal calendar observances.
The recorded source page is verified independently of any unique-practice identity, app publication or liturgical approval.
